title: Running on a supported host (native Windows, or Ubuntu inside WSL2)
WSL2 (not WSL1)
detail: not applicable: a native Windows run involves no WSL at all (the WSL-specific checks are skipped)

title: x86_64 CPU architecture
WSL2 GPU device present (/dev/dxg)
nvidia-smi works and sees a GPU
GPU is an RTX 4070
GPU has enough VRAM for this model set
NVIDIA driver supports CUDA 13.0 (needed by the locked PyTorch)
detail: could not read 'CUDA Version' from nvidia-smi
fix: Run nvidia-smi and check the CUDA Version in its header.

title: System Python 3 is recent enough for this driver
detail: Python 3.12.10 (the project environment uses its own Python 3.12 from uv)

title: uv (Python package manager) is installed
git is installed
Repository revision recorded
detail: commit 60ffb1a558 with local changes (15 files): results will say so
fix: Run `git status` and undo local edits unless the maintainer asked for them.

title: Repository location (Linux filesystem under WSL, anywhere local on native Windows)
detail: native Windows path: E:\smol-harness (the /mnt slowness trap only exists under WSL; the workspaces must still be disposable)

title: Enough free disk space
Enough memory available to the experiment
Project environment exists (.venv)
effGen 1.3.0 and the harness import correctly
PyTorch sees and can compute on the GPU (no CPU fallback)
detail: torch 2.14.1+cpu (CUDA build None) reports no CUDA device
fix: Check the driver (see the driver_cuda check) and `nvidia-smi`; do not continue on CPU.

title: bitsandbytes pinned version (NF4 quantization)
fix: python3 experiments/rtx4070/rtx4070.py install-deps   (or use --profile fallback, which needs no bitsandbytes)

title: Shell tool runs a command through the sandbox backend
Experiment workspaces are disposable and safe
detail: E:\smol-harness\experiments\rtx4070\results\work (created per run, never reused, deleted after each attempt)

title: Ollama server reachable
detail: Ollama 0.40.6 at http://127.0.0.1:11434 (the Windows app is the intended setup on this host).

title: Windows host is unreachable from the shell sandbox (stage E only; on native Windows the declared no-confinement scope applies)
detail: native Windows: the shell backend runs a model's commands as your user (muj) with NO filesystem or network confinement (PowerShell + Job Object kill-tree only). Stage E under this scope means: trusted, disposable repositories only; every artifact is redacted; do not point the workspaces at anything with secrets. WSL2 remains the confined option.
